body: postgres 16 primary runs on ceph-node-07, replica on ceph-node-09
correction: postgres primary moved to ceph-node-09, ceph-node-07 is decommissioned
failover procedure: promote replica with pg_ctl promote, update haproxy backend
ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED fires when the intake connection pool exceeds 4096
api service deploys from repo punk-api via argocd
rollout policy: canary at 10 percent, then full fleet
k8s cluster, also called kubernetes, runs calico cni with three control plane nodes
maintenance window 2026-07-14 02:00 to 04:00 UTC reserved for the ceph upgrade
ceph upgrade order: mons first, then osd hosts one rack at a time
